profiles.label: Profile F0 PR #107 carry-forward baseline
profiles.torchCudaExpectation: torch 2.7.1 / CUDA 12.6 packages inherited from PR #104 image
profiles.rationale: Carry forward PR #107 K0/K2 Cloud Run L4 import-smoke evidence without rebuilding; expected failure is cuGreenCtxDestroy.
riskNotes: no new build needed for F0 because PR #107 already captured the baseline failure

profiles.label: Profile F1 minimal fixed sgl-kernel 0.3.6.post1
profiles.torchCudaExpectation: keeps PR #104 torch/CUDA package base and replaces only sgl-kernel with the post-#9021 issue-linked fixed wheel
profiles.rationale: Use the smallest upstream-evidence-driven change: sgl-kernel 0.3.6.post1 was published after PR #9021/#9231 and is referenced by issue discussion as the fixed path.
riskNotes: no-deps reinstall is intentional to avoid broad dependency churn
import smoke must prove compatibility before model-copy or generated runtime

profiles.label: Profile F2 current stable SGLang release dependency set
profiles.torchCudaExpectation: current SGLang dependency set includes torch 2.11.0, CUDA-oriented packages, and sglang-kernel 0.4.2.post2; Cloud Run L4 import smoke must prove driver compatibility
profiles.rationale: Use the latest stable SGLang package metadata rather than manually pairing old packages.
riskNotes: large dependency churn and CUDA >12.2 packages may require Cloud Run forward compatibility
import smoke must pass before runtime; generated fixtures are not attempted on package-install evidence alone

profiles.label: Profile F3 latest kernel overlay on PR #104 base
profiles.torchCudaExpectation: keeps PR #104 runtime package base but overlays current kernel wheels; import smoke decides compatibility
profiles.rationale: Test the current kernel packages independently from the full latest SGLang dependency set.
riskNotes: API mismatch with SGLang 0.4.10 is possible; import smoke classifies this before runtime

profiles.label: Profile F4 CUDA forward-compatible image path
profiles.rationale: Cloud Run docs allow CUDA >12.2 only with forward compatibility packages or a suitable NVIDIA base image; exact LD_LIBRARY_PATH/base-image decision remains blocked until F1-F3 evidence requires it.
riskNotes: do not override Cloud Run driver libraries without exact evidence and import-smoke validation

profiles.label: Profile F5 official SGLang image overlay
profiles.rationale: Official Docker Hub images exist, but this phase requires an exact verified tag before use.
riskNotes: do not pull floating latest or dev images into a beta-readiness chain

profiles.label: Profile F6 source-build after PR #9021/#9231
profiles.rationale: Reserved for a human-approved source-build investigation if all wheel/image paths fail.
riskNotes: large CUDA source build may exceed bounded Cloud Build budget and requires explicit approval
